local_windows: nonoverlapping 2048 raw rows per segment, retain final remainder only if >=1536; Welch on 2047 derivatives

spectral_null.kind: within-segment random permutation, test maximum PSD over fixed registered band
spectral_null.limitation: Tests temporal ordering versus exchangeability, not physics; no global multiple-comparison adjustment

coherence: scipy.signal.coherence with identical segment/Welch parameters; no phase inference; no independent significance claim
phase_condition: only if rotation units verified; otherwise explicit NOT_PERFORMED
